messages.content: 約翰有5000美元想要投資。他正在考慮兩個選項。第一個選項是一個每年以4%的年利率按季度複利計算的儲蓄帳戶，為期5年。第二個選項是一個每年以3.5%的年利率提供單利的債券，為期5年。在5年後，約翰會有多少錢？

function.name: financial_compound_interest
function.description: Calculates compound interest. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

principle.description: The initial amount of money that is being compounded.

rate.description: The annual interest rate, as a decimal. E.g., an annual interest rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05. This is a float type value.

time.description: The amount of time, in years, that the money is to be compounded for.

n.description: The number of times interest applied per time period.

message.content:
**John’s investment outcomes after 5 years** | Option | Calculation | Result | |--------|-------------|-------| | **Savings account – 4 % APR, quarterly compounding** | \(A = P\left(1+\frac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}\)
with
\(\displaystyle P = \$5\,000,\quad r = 0.04,\quad n = 4,\quad t = 5\) | \[ A = 5\,000\Bigl(1 + \tfrac{0.04}{4}\Bigr)^{4\times5} = 5\,000(1.01)^{20} \approx 5\,000 \times 1.22111 \approx \$6\,105.55 \] | | **Bond – 3.5 % APR, simple interest** | \(A = P(1 + rt)\)
or equivalently
\(\text{Interest}=Prt\) | \[ I = 5\,000 \times 0.035 \times 5 = 5\,000 \times 0.175 = \$875\\[4pt] A = 5\,000 + I = 5\,000 + 875 = \$5\,875 \] | ### Bottom line After five years, investing in the savings account yields roughly **\$6,106**, whereas the bond provides about **\$5,875**—a difference of approximately **\$231** favoring the compound‑interest option.
